/* AppAdminTbmMapper.selectManageSessions */ SELECT A.SESSION_CD AS sessionCd , A.SITE_CD AS siteCd , ST.SITE_NM AS siteNm , A.TITLE AS title , A.STATUS_CD AS statusCd , SC.SYST_VAL_D_NM AS statusNm , A.EDU_MINUTES AS eduMinutes , A.MANAGER_USER_CD AS managerUserCd , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(A.CMPNY_CD, 'USER_NM', A.MANAGER_USER_CD, NULL) AS managerUserNm , DATE_FORMAT(A.OPENED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS openedAt , DATE_FORMAT(A.STARTED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS startedAt , DATE_FORMAT(A.ENDED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS endedAt , DATE_FORMAT(A.INSERT_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS insertDate , ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_TBM_SESSION_RISK R WHERE R.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND R.SESSION_CD = A.SESSION_CD ) AS riskCount /* [정합성 수정] 참석자수 = 실입실(ENTRY_AT IS NOT NULL) 기준. 미입실자는 집계 제외. */ , ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_TBM_ATTENDANCE AT /* PRAFTA-SUBCON-T5: 참석자 회사 조건 제거 — 타사(지정 체인) 참석자를 개설사 집계에 포함. 인가 전제: 바깥 WHERE(세션 소유 A.CMPNY_CD = gvCmpnyCd)가 집계 대상 세션을 이미 제한한다. */ WHERE AT.SESSION_CD = A.SESSION_CD AND AT.DEL_YN = 'N' AND AT.ENTRY_AT IS NOT NULL ) AS attendanceCount /* 이수자수 = 실입실 + COMPLETION_STATUS_CD='COMPLETED'. */ , ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_TBM_ATTENDANCE AT /* PRAFTA-SUBCON-T5: 참석자 회사 조건 제거 — 타사(지정 체인) 참석자를 개설사 집계에 포함. 인가 전제: 바깥 WHERE(세션 소유 A.CMPNY_CD = gvCmpnyCd)가 집계 대상 세션을 이미 제한한다. */ WHERE AT.SESSION_CD = A.SESSION_CD AND AT.DEL_YN = 'N' AND AT.ENTRY_AT IS NOT NULL AND AT.COMPLETION_STATUS_CD = 'COMPLETED' ) AS completedCount /* 미이수자수 = 실입실 + 미완료(상태 NULL=미완료 또는 NOT_COMPLETED). 자동이수 폐지로 NULL 포함 필수. */ , ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_TBM_ATTENDANCE AT /* PRAFTA-SUBCON-T5: 참석자 회사 조건 제거 — 타사(지정 체인) 참석자를 개설사 집계에 포함. 인가 전제: 바깥 WHERE(세션 소유 A.CMPNY_CD = gvCmpnyCd)가 집계 대상 세션을 이미 제한한다. */ WHERE AT.SESSION_CD = A.SESSION_CD AND AT.DEL_YN = 'N' AND AT.ENTRY_AT IS NOT NULL AND (AT.COMPLETION_STATUS_CD IS NULL OR AT.COMPLETION_STATUS_CD = 'NOT_COMPLETED') ) AS notCompletedCount FROM TB_TBM_SESSION A LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_SITE ST ON ( A.CMPNY_CD = ST.CMPNY_CD AND A.SITE_CD = ST.SITE_CD ) LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT D.SYST_VAL_D_CD, D.SYST_VAL_D_NM FROM TB_SYST_VAL_D D WHERE D.SYST_VAL_CD = 'SYS046' AND D.USE_YN = 'Y' ) SC ON ( A.STATUS_CD = SC.SYST_VAL_D_CD )
ORDER BY CASE A.STATUS_CD WHEN 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN 1 WHEN 'OPENED' THEN 2 WHEN 'DRAFT' THEN 3 ELSE 9 END , A.INSERT_DATE DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}

/* AppAdminTbmMapper.selectSessionDetail */ SELECT A.SESSION_CD AS sessionCd , A.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , A.SITE_CD AS siteCd , ST.SITE_NM AS siteNm , A.EDU_TYPE_CD AS eduTypeCd , A.TITLE AS title , A.CONTENT_BODY AS contentBody , A.CONTENT_FORMAT_CD AS contentFormatCd , A.STATUS_CD AS statusCd , SC.SYST_VAL_D_NM AS statusNm , A.ENTRY_PWD AS entryPwd , A.EXIT_PWD AS exitPwd , A.MANAGER_USER_CD AS managerUserCd , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(A.CMPNY_CD, 'USER_NM', A.MANAGER_USER_CD, NULL) AS managerUserNm
, A.MANAGER_GPS_LAT AS managerGpsLat , A.MANAGER_GPS_LON AS managerGpsLon , A.MANAGER_GPS_LAT_ENC AS managerGpsLatEnc , A.MANAGER_GPS_LON_ENC AS managerGpsLonEnc , A.GPS_VERIFY_TYPE_CD AS gpsVerifyTypeCd , A.GPS_VERIFY_RADIUS_M AS gpsVerifyRadiusM , A.EDU_MINUTES AS eduMinutes , A.GPS_MANUAL_CONFIRM_YN AS gpsManualConfirmYn , DATE_FORMAT(A.OPENED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS openedAt /* 교육준비 타이머 기준시각(15분 자동 교육시작 기준). FE 카운트다운용 — 초 단위까지 노출. */ , DATE_FORMAT(A.PREP_START_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS prepStartAt , DATE_FORMAT(A.STARTED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS startedAt , DATE_FORMAT(A.ENDED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS endedAt , DATE_FORMAT(A.CANCELLED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS cancelledAt , A.CANCEL_REASON AS cancelReason , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(A.CMPNY_CD, 'USER_NM', A.INSERT_NO, NULL) AS insertNm , DATE_FORMAT(A.INSERT_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS insertDate /* 준비 타이머 절대시각(epoch 초) - 세션 타임존으로 해석되므로 저장 TZ(UTC/KST) 가정이 불필요. KST 전환(2026-08-30) 후 벽시계+Z 산출이 9시간 밀리던 결함의 수정 축. */ , UNIX_TIMESTAMP(A.PREP_START_AT) AS prepStartAtEpoch /* tbm04-manager-sign: 주관자 서명 여부/시각(이력 상세 노출 판단·표시). record 끝 2필드와 순서 일치. 시각 표기는 파일 내 표준(DATE_FORMAT 직표시 — KST 전환 완료 전제, endedAt 과 동일 방식). */ , CASE WHEN A.MANAGER_SIGN_FILE_MGMT_CD IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS managerSignYn , DATE_FORMAT(A.MANAGER_SIGNED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS managerSignedAt FROM TB_TBM_SESSION A LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_SITE ST ON ( A.CMPNY_CD = ST.CMPNY_CD AND A.SITE_CD = ST.SITE_CD ) LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT D.SYST_VAL_D_CD, D.SYST_VAL_D_NM FROM TB_SYST_VAL_D D WHERE D.SYST_VAL_CD = 'SYS046' AND D.USE_YN = 'Y' ) SC ON ( A.STATUS_CD = SC.SYST_VAL_D_CD ) WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND A.SESSION_CD = #{sessionCd} AND A.DEL_YN = 'N'

/* AppAdminTbmMapper.selectSessionGuard */ SELECT A.SESSION_CD AS sessionCd , A.SITE_CD AS siteCd , A.STATUS_CD AS statusCd , A.MANAGER_USER_CD AS managerUserCd , U.NODE_CD AS managerNodeCd , A.GPS_VERIFY_TYPE_CD AS gpsVerifyTypeCd /* 교육준비(prepare) DB값 기준 교육시간 필수검증용 */ , A.EDU_MINUTES AS eduMinutes /* tbm04-manager-sign: 사후서명 중복 가드용(존재=이미 서명). record 마지막 필드와 순서 일치 */ , A.MANAGER_SIGN_FILE_MGMT_CD AS managerSignFileMgmtCd FROM TB_TBM_SESSION A LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_USER U ON ( A.CMPNY_CD = U.CMPNY_CD AND A.MANAGER_USER_CD = U.USER_CD ) WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND A.SESSION_CD = #{sessionCd} AND A.DEL_YN = 'N'

/* AppAdminTbmMapper.selectSessionContents */ SELECT SC.MTRL_CD AS mtrlCd , M.TITLE AS title , M.MTRL_TYPE AS mtrlType , BD.BAIM_VAL_D_NM AS mtrlTypeNm , ( SELECT COUNT(I.MTRL_ITEM_CD) FROM TB_TBM_EDU_MTRL_ITEM I /* 테넌트 격리: MTRL_CD 는 회사별 채번이라 전역 유일하지 않다. 항목의 CMPNY_CD 로 함께 좁힌다. */ WHERE I.CMPNY_CD = SC.CMPNY_CD AND I.MTRL_CD = SC.MTRL_CD AND I.USE_YN = 'Y' ) AS itemCnt , SC.DISPLAY_ORDER AS displayOrder , SC.OVERRIDE_DESC AS overrideDesc FROM TB_TBM_SESSION_CONTENT SC LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_TBM_EDU_MTRL M ON ( SC.MTRL_CD = M.MTRL_CD AND SC.CMPNY_CD = M.CMPNY_CD ) LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_BAIM_VAL_D BD ON ( BD.CMPNY_CD = SC.CMPNY_CD AND BD.BAIM_VAL_CD = 'COM003' AND BD.BAIM_VAL_D_CD = M.MTRL_TYPE AND BD.USE_YN = 'Y' ) WHERE SC.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND SC.SESSION_CD = #{sessionCd} ORDER BY SC.DISPLAY_ORDER

/* AppAdminTbmMapper.selectSessionRisks */ SELECT SR.SITE_CD AS siteCd , SR.PROCESS_CD AS processCd , C.BAIM_VAL_D_NM AS processNm , RA.RISK_TYPE_CD AS riskTypeCd , RT.RISK_TYPE_NM AS riskTypeNm , RA.HAZARD_CD AS hazardCd , CASE WHEN RA.HAZARD_CD = 'self' THEN RA.ASSESSMENT_DESC ELSE E.HAZARD_NM END AS hazardNm , SR.ASSESSMENT_CD AS assessmentCd , RA.ASSESSMENT_STATUS AS assessmentStatus , B.SYST_VAL_D_NM AS assessmentStatusNm , SR.DISPLAY_ORDER AS displayOrder FROM TB_TBM_SESSION_RISK SR INNER JOIN TB_RISK_ASSESSMENT RA ON ( SR.CMPNY_CD = RA.CMPNY_CD AND SR.SITE_CD = RA.SITE_CD AND SR.PROCESS_CD = RA.PROCESS_CD AND SR.ASSESSMENT_CD = RA.ASSESSMENT_CD ) LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT D.SYST_VAL_D_CD, D.SYST_VAL_D_NM FROM TB_SYST_VAL_D D WHERE D.SYST_VAL_CD = 'SYS011' AND D.USE_YN = 'Y' ) B ON ( RA.ASSESSMENT_STATUS = B.SYST_VAL_D_CD ) LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_BAIM_VAL_D C ON ( C.CMPNY_CD = RA.CMPNY_CD AND C.BAIM_VAL_CD = 'COM002' AND C.BAIM_VAL_D_CD = RA.PROCESS_CD AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' ) LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_RISK_TYPE RT ON ( RA.CMPNY_CD = RT.CMPNY_CD AND RA.RISK_TYPE_CD = RT.RISK_TYPE_CD ) LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_RISK_SITE_HAZARD E ON ( RA.CMPNY_CD = E.CMPNY_CD AND RA.RISK_TYPE_CD = E.RISK_TYPE_CD AND RA.HAZARD_CD = E.HAZARD_CD ) WHERE SR.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND SR.SESSION_CD = #{sessionCd} ORDER BY SR.DISPLAY_ORDER
mapper.update: /* AppAdminTbmMapper.upsertSessionState */ INSERT INTO TB_TBM_SESSION_STATE ( CMPNY_CD , SESSION_CD , CURRENT_SLIDE_INDEX , SYNC_STATE_CD , LAST_UPDATED_BY , INSERT_NO , INSERT_DATE ) VALUES ( #{gvCmpnyCd} , #{sessionCd} , 0 , 'PAUSED' , #{gvUserCd} , #{gvUserCd} , NOW() ) AS NEW ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE CURRENT_SLIDE_INDEX = NEW.CURRENT_SLIDE_INDEX , SYNC_STATE_CD = NEW.SYNC_STATE_CD , LAST_UPDATED_BY = NEW.LAST_UPDATED_BY , UPDATE_NO = NEW.INSERT_NO , UPDATE_DATE = NOW()

/* AppAdminTbmMapper.evaluateAutoStart */ UPDATE TB_TBM_SESSION SET STATUS_CD = 'IN_PROGRESS' , STARTED_AT = NOW() , UPDATE_NO = 'SYSTEM' , UPDATE_DATE = NOW() WHERE CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND SESSION_CD = #{sessionCd} AND DEL_YN = 'N' AND STATUS_CD = 'OPENED' AND PREP_START_AT IS NOT NULL AND TIMESTAMPADD(MINUTE, #{minutes}, PREP_START_AT) <= NOW()

/* AppAdminTbmMapper.selectSessionAttendeesAdmin */ SELECT AT.ATTENDANCE_CD AS attendanceCd , CASE WHEN AT.USER_TYPE_CD = 'REGULAR' THEN RU.USER_NM ELSE DU.USER_NM END AS userNm , AT.USER_TYPE_CD AS userTypeCd , ND.NODE_NM AS deptNm , DATE_FORMAT(AT.ENTRY_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS entryAt , (AT.EXIT_AT IS NOT NULL) AS exited , DATE_FORMAT(AT.EXIT_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS exitAt , AT.COMPLETION_STATUS_CD AS completionStatusCd /* prafta-051 R-C(E12): 교육준비 GPS 이탈자 판단용 입실 거리(대리입실은 NULL). 보안 검토(최소노출): 정밀 입실좌표(ENTRY_GPS_LAT/LON)는 프론트 무참조라 SELECT 제외 */ , AT.ENTRY_DISTANCE_M AS distanceM /* PRAFTA-SUBCON-T5: 참석자 소속 회사코드(서비스가 1차 relabel 하여 응답에 담는다). */ , AT.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd FROM TB_TBM_ATTENDANCE AT LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_USER RU ON ( AT.USER_TYPE_CD = 'REGULAR' AND AT.CMPNY_CD = RU.CMPNY_CD AND AT.USER_CD = RU.USER_CD ) LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_DAILY_USER DU ON ( AT.USER_TYPE_CD = 'DAILY' AND AT.CMPNY_CD = DU.CMPNY_CD AND AT.USER_CD = DU.USER_CD ) LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_SITE_NODE ND ON ( AT.USER_TYPE_CD = 'REGULAR' AND RU.CMPNY_CD = ND.CMPNY_CD AND RU.SITE_CD = ND.SITE_CD AND RU.NODE_CD = ND.NODE_CD )
WHERE AT.SESSION_CD = #{sessionCd} AND AT.DEL_YN = 'N' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_TBM_SESSION S WHERE S.SESSION_CD = #{sessionCd} AND S.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} ) /* phase=LIVE: 입실자만(ENTRY_AT IS NOT NULL). COMPLETED: 출결 전체 */
AND AT.ENTRY_AT IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY AT.ENTRY_AT IS NULL, AT.ENTRY_AT, AT.ATTENDANCE_CD LIMIT 500

/* AppAdminTbmMapper.selectSessionContentItems */ SELECT I.MTRL_CD AS mtrlCd , I.MTRL_ITEM_CD AS mtrlItemCd , I.MTRL_ITEM_TYPE AS itemType , I.FILE_MGMT_CD AS fileMgmtCd , I.URL AS url , I.MTRL_DESC AS itemDesc , I.SORT_IDX AS sortIdx /* 서명 URL 전환: 파일 원시 경로/확장자(서비스에서 FileUrlSigner 로 서명). 파일 없으면 NULL. */ , F.FILE_PATH AS filePath , F.FILE_EXT AS fileExt FROM TB_TBM_EDU_MTRL_ITEM I /* 테넌트 격리: MTRL_CD 는 회사별 채번이라 전역 유일하지 않다. 회사코드를 조인키에 포함한다. */ INNER JOIN TB_TBM_SESSION_CONTENT SC ON ( I.CMPNY_CD = SC.CMPNY_CD AND I.MTRL_CD = SC.MTRL_CD ) LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_FILE_INFO F ON ( F.CMPNY_CD = SC.CMPNY_CD AND F.FILE_MGMT_CD = I.FILE_MGMT_CD ) WHERE SC.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} /* 테넌트 격리: 항목(I) 자신의 CMPNY_CD 도 직접 좁힌다. */ AND I.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND SC.SESSION_CD = #{sessionCd} AND I.USE_YN = 'Y' /* 회사 격리 보강: 항목이 속한 교육자료(M)가 동일 회사 소유인지 EXISTS 가드 */ AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_TBM_EDU_MTRL M WHERE M.MTRL_CD = I.MTRL_CD AND M.CMPNY_CD = I.CMPNY_CD ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_TBM_SESSION S WHERE S.CMPNY_CD = SC.CMPNY_CD AND S.SESSION_CD = SC.SESSION_CD AND S.DEL_YN = 'N' ) ORDER BY SC.DISPLAY_ORDER, I.SORT_IDX

/* AppAdminTbmMapper.selectAdminEduMaterials */ SELECT A.MTRL_CD AS mtrlCd , A.TITLE AS title , A.MTRL_TYPE AS mtrlType , BD.BAIM_VAL_D_NM AS mtrlTypeNm , A.SITE_CD AS siteCd , CASE WHEN A.SITE_CD IS NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS isCommonContent , A.CONTENTS AS contents , ( SELECT COUNT(I.MTRL_ITEM_CD) FROM TB_TBM_EDU_MTRL_ITEM I /* 테넌트 격리: MTRL_CD 는 회사별 채번이라 전역 유일하지 않다. 항목의 CMPNY_CD 로 함께 좁힌다. */ WHERE I.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND I.MTRL_CD = A.MTRL_CD AND I.USE_YN = 'Y' ) AS itemCnt , A.USE_YN AS useYn , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(A.CMPNY_CD, 'USER_NM', A.INSERT_NO, NULL) AS insertNm , DATE_FORMAT(A.INSERT_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS insertDate FROM TB_TBM_EDU_MTRL A LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_BAIM_VAL_D BD ON ( BD.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND BD.BAIM_VAL_CD = 'COM003' AND BD.BAIM_VAL_D_CD = A.MTRL_TYPE AND BD.USE_YN = 'Y' )
ORDER BY A.INSERT_DATE DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}

/* AppAdminTbmMapper.selectAdminEduMaterial */ SELECT A.MTRL_CD AS mtrlCd , A.TITLE AS title , A.MTRL_TYPE AS mtrlType , BD.BAIM_VAL_D_NM AS mtrlTypeNm , A.CONTENTS AS contents , A.SITE_CD AS siteCd , CASE WHEN A.SITE_CD IS NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS isCommonContent , A.USE_YN AS useYn , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(A.CMPNY_CD, 'USER_NM', A.INSERT_NO, NULL) AS insertNm , DATE_FORMAT(A.INSERT_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS insertDate FROM TB_TBM_EDU_MTRL A LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_BAIM_VAL_D BD ON ( BD.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND BD.BAIM_VAL_CD = 'COM003' AND BD.BAIM_VAL_D_CD = A.MTRL_TYPE AND BD.USE_YN = 'Y' ) WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND A.MTRL_CD = #{mtrlCd}

/* AppAdminTbmMapper.selectAdminEduMaterialItems */ SELECT I.MTRL_ITEM_CD AS mtrlItemCd , I.MTRL_ITEM_TYPE AS mtrlItemType , I.MTRL_DESC AS mtrlDesc , I.FILE_MGMT_CD AS fileMgmtCd , I.THUMB_FILE_MGMT_CD AS thumbFileMgmtCd , I.DURATION_SEC AS durationSec , I.URL AS url , I.SORT_IDX AS sortIdx /* 서명 URL 전환: SQL CONCAT 제거. 원시 경로/확장자만 반환하고 서비스에서 FileUrlSigner 로 서명. */ , F.FILE_PATH AS filePath , F.FILE_EXT AS fileExt FROM TB_TBM_EDU_MTRL_ITEM I
INNER JOIN TB_TBM_EDU_MTRL M ON ( I.CMPNY_CD = M.CMPNY_CD AND I.MTRL_CD = M.MTRL_CD ) LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_FILE_INFO F ON ( F.CMPNY_CD = M.CMPNY_CD AND F.FILE_MGMT_CD = I.FILE_MGMT_CD ) WHERE I.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND I.MTRL_CD = #{mtrlCd} AND I.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY I.SORT_IDX

/* AppAdminTbmMapper.selectAdminHistory */ SELECT A.SESSION_CD AS sessionCd , A.SITE_CD AS siteCd , ST.SITE_NM AS siteNm , A.TITLE AS title , A.STATUS_CD AS statusCd , SC.SYST_VAL_D_NM AS statusNm , A.MANAGER_USER_CD AS managerUserCd , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(A.CMPNY_CD, 'USER_NM', A.MANAGER_USER_CD, NULL) AS managerUserNm , DATE_FORMAT(A.OPENED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS openedAt , TB_TBM_SESSION_RISK R WHERE R.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND R.SESSION_CD = A.SESSION_CD ) AS riskCount /* [정합성 수정] 참석자수 = 실입실(ENTRY_AT IS NOT NULL) 기준. 미입실자는 집계 제외. */ , ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM 타사(지정 체인) 참석자를 개설사 집계에 포함. 인가 전제: 바깥 WHERE(세션 소유 A.CMPNY_CD = gvCmpnyCd)가 집계 대상 세션을 이미 제한한다. */ WHERE AT.SESSION_CD = A.SESSION_CD AND AT.DEL_YN = 'N' AND AT.ENTRY_AT IS NOT NULL AND AT.COMPLETION_STATUS_CD = 'COMPLETED' ) AS completedCount /* 미이수자수 = 실입실 + 미완료(상태 NULL=미완료 또는 NOT_COMPLETED). 자동이수 폐지로 NULL 포함 필수. */ , ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_TBM_ATTENDANCE AT /* PRAFTA-SUBCON-T5: 참석자 회사 조건 제거 — 타사(지정 체인) 참석자를 개설사 집계에 포함. 인가 전제: 바깥 WHERE(세션 소유 A.CMPNY_CD = gvCmpnyCd)가 집계 대상 세션을 이미 제한한다. */ WHERE AT.SESSION_CD = A.SESSION_CD AND AT.DEL_YN = 'N' AND AT.ENTRY_AT IS NOT NULL AND (AT.COMPLETION_STATUS_CD IS NULL OR AT.COMPLETION_STATUS_CD = 'NOT_COMPLETED') ) AS notCompletedCount FROM TB_TBM_SESSION A LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_SITE ST ON ( A.CMPNY_CD = ST.CMPNY_CD AND A.SITE_CD = ST.SITE_CD ) LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT D.SYST_VAL_D_CD, D.SYST_VAL_D_NM FROM TB_SYST_VAL_D D WHERE D.SYST_VAL_CD = 'SYS046' AND D.USE_YN = 'Y' ) SC ON ( A.STATUS_CD = SC.SYST_VAL_D_CD )
ORDER BY IFNULL(A.ENDED_AT, A.INSERT_DATE) DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
